reviews.t: Hard to apply (impossible so far), but pretty
reviews.x: I'm going to be honest, I still haven't figured out how to put these on right. They stick to the tweezers when you try applying with the tweezers, and stick in a straight line halfway down your lashes when you don't. I finally just put on magnetic liner to help get them to stay on my lashline, which is a bummer because I bought these hoping I wouldn't need the liner. They do look pretty nice once you get them on right, though. They're plenty thick and very noticeable. If you're looking for natur
I love love love 💕 them!! Hecka easy to put on no glue needed. I’ve been rocking double magnetic eyelashes for over a year.
Impossibile to apply.  If I want to keep them,  I will have to use magnetic liner, which I was hoping not to use.  I should've read the reviews before I bought them.
Difficult to put on as one piece. The trick for me was to cut bottom lashes into three pieces and now super easy topa put on. Ordering another set.

I don't know if it's the lashes themselves or just user error, but I can't figure out how to get these lashes to bend with the shape of my eye. The magnets seem to work well and if I could get them to apply correctly, they look nice, but every time I try to apply them either the inside corner or the outside edge flies away from my lash line. I tried using the provided applicator, but the lash magnets aren't strong enough to pull the lashes away from the applicator, so when I try to pull the tool
These might work if you have super thick lashes but the applicator doesn't hold them far enough apart and I can't get them to clamp near my lash line at all I'm very disappointed.
They don’t stay on. It’s VERY hard to apply them. They’re not long enough for my eyes. (They don’t go all the way to the end of front of my eye lid) they just suck in general.

A lot more difficult to use than it seems, after 20 minutes I gave up and I tried both methods at applying. They don’t release well from the tweezers and it’s difficult to try the other method. I feel like this was a complete waste of money. I’ll stick with the magnetic liner instead.

Absolutely the worst lashes I have ever tried in my life!!  First thing I noticed was the lashes were not in the correct spots in the case, had to rearrange and pair them correctly.  Very hard to apply and once applied they cannot be adjusted, so however they snap together is how they stay! They feel horrible very thick very stiff and coarse like baby doll lashes.  They do not curve to your natural lashes at all they feel very heavy on your natural lashes.  Almost immediately a magnet fell off.
They would slide right off my lashes  but the magnets stuck together tightly
Theyre extremely tricky to apply but they look nice after you do.

reviews.t: Pestaña con iman, Una esquina me quedaba levantada.
reviews.x: Muy bonita presentación pero muy muy muy complicada para colocar y las 2 ocasiones que quise usarla no me quedo bien y termine por volverlas a la caja...

Wish I would have read these reviews before I bought these eye lashes. I’ve tried a few times now... 20-30 minutes at a time and I still can’t apply these eyelashes. You try using the applicator and the lashes do connect but as soon as you pull away from your eye the lashes come with the applicator. Also, if you’re uncoordinated like me the other method is totally useless also. Very disappointed with the buy. Do not recommend.

reviews.t: Does not work as advertised (AT ALL)! Don't waste your money!
reviews.x: These are impossible to use! Once each eyelash is connected to the applicator, then they won't connect to each other because the magnetic in the applicator is stronger! And forget trying to manually apply. Picture trying to balance one eyelash on your eyelashes while attaching another from the bottom! The top eyelash will jump off to connect to the other one before you can even get it close! Don't waste your money.
These were a little tricky to put on but once you get it it becomes easy. They are so lightweight and comfortable I forgot I even had them on. I love that there's no nasty glue or chemicals!

reviews.t: I will not recommend these at all
reviews.x: These are impossible to put on. They have magnets on them and the holder to put them on keeps pulling them off once you finally get them on. I would not recommend these at all.

I also don’t like that the bottom strip is a lot sma

They just won’t stay on my lashes. They stick to the tool or they just stick to each other idk. I’ve tried for days and can’t g

Like others mentioned these were tricky to put on! It’s getting easier and I never use the tool it comes with because the lashes wanted to stick to it rather than each other. I love that they don’t require eye liner or glue tho. And they stay put for the whole day. I recommend applying a light layer of mascara before adding your lashes. It helps them stay in place. I like the thickness and overall look of these. I really liked the sparkly magnetic strips that keep them in place in their box.

reviews.t: Tool doesn't work but it's still not too bad
reviews.x: The applicator is completely metal so it does Not want to come they did understand and refunded Me immediately and told me to keep it. You could still Find a use In it As extra pairs if you have magnetic eyeliner if you can't use the tool. I'm disappointed it didn't work For the reason I bought it but if you need extra pairs this is the same price as the one pair I bought at Walmart just Get Some eyeliner

Thickness is great when you put them together they look beautiful but the magnets on them quickly just fell off and I haven't even used them. I literally just received them today and two of them have a missing magnet. I decided test it out and it wasn't the easiest to use only because the magnets on the lashes would stay attached to the tool it comes with thats supposed to make it easier to use.

reviews.t: Lashes are OK, tool is useless.
reviews.x: The lashes themselves are OK, pretty much what you'd expect for a low price.  Bought this for the application tool, which has so far proven useless. I'm a relatively dexterous person,  but I've not yet been able to actually get a set to properly join around my own lashes. I tried a friend's slightly different tool and it was a game changer. Save your money.

Lashes are straight so they are extremely difficult to put on with the curve of the lash line. In fact, after several attempts I was never able to get them on any other way but a straight line. Not enough magnets on the lashes and the lashes were not in the case next to the appropriately labeled marker. Absolutely do not waste your time.

reviews.t: Great value, not easy to apply
reviews.x: They are as easy as 123. I tried using the applicator but they won't release from it. So the lashes do magnet together but then when I open applicator they go.with it. I tried not using applicator even worse. I purchased the eye liner magnetic.ones and they worked great. I jiat wanted to be able to use these without magnetic liner. :(

claims.text: Many reviewers find the lashes very difficult or impossible to apply, often giving up after repeated attempts.
Some reviewers say the lashes are easy to apply once you get the hang of it, and a few describe them as comfortable and lightweight.
Several reviewers report problems with the applicator or tweezers, such as lashes sticking to the tool or not releasing properly.
A number of reviewers find the lashes look nice or pretty once applied, despite the application difficulty.
Some reviewers mention fit or staying-on issues, including lashes not being long enough or sliding off.
